definition: An interview schedule is a structured set of questions used to assess a person in a consistent way during an interview. In this context, it refers to a brief, standardised format that can be used to measure depressive symptoms or relapse over a defined recent period.

reasons: The packet does not define the general term “interview schedule”; it discusses a specific instrument called the “retrospective Clinical Interview Schedule Revised (rCIS-R).”
